title: SiDiary-Export did not contain other Therapeutic Data (KH,IE, ect)
body: It seems that only the CGMS Data are included in the Export for SiDiary. For a overall-View and discussion with the doctor a complete export should be possible.

comments.body: I have a short look to the sources, and think the implementation will not that difficult. So I'll try it in my Fork. If everything is ok and working I'll come back, if ok for you, with the changes...

@MasterPlexus, that would be great. I wrote the export at a time where there was no treatment data in xDrip.
Do you know the import format specifications for SiDiary? Can CGM-Data and Treatments be mixed together?

I think it would be best to export a second file with MBG data (from calibrations ans also those not used as calibrations) including the carbs (does SiDiary expect g of carbs or German "BE"?) and insulin.

I'm looking forward to hearing how it goes :+1:

Doing it a little bit. Locally it works, but I wondering in that the time stamp seems to be not absolute. In my build environment the emulator is 2 hours ago to nowtime, and the export had the same move in the time-export. But maybe this is something I did not recognized before in Java or SQLite-library...
If you want to have a look (for sure,the implementation is more rough then nice ;) )
https://github.com/MasterPlexus/xDrip/commit/4b9e101bce926690721b31fedf0dd6858632f8e9

Yes, this makes no issue. The order can be as you want in the CSV file. 
OK. Will test the timezone tomorrow, with the other corrections ;)

So did the translation (CHO) and some typos. Also tried the Timezone, but bring no change.As this will only are a problem if the time of the Phone is set to a other area, this is not a urgent problem think. 

Could it be, that the BloodTest is an not used Table, and all Measurements are stored in the Calibration-Table? So I did not Include the BloodTest for now...

https://github.com/MasterPlexus/xDrip/commit/11a4a88f5fe1a82fb39ec3a784b88bf80d0c42cf

PS: I'm up to not so familiar with the CSV in Android studio, so I made in mistake two commits with the same description :(

@AdrianLxM , could you explain, what the Table BloodTest is for? I assume that this table will be filled not by manual entrys of the user, but if there will put also Values from other places (like bluetooth Measurement or something else what I did not know), that this should be also in the export... Forme the question ist, is there, if this table will be used, then also every time a entry in the Calibration-Table? If yes, then I would say only use the calibration-Table for BG export. If the answer ist sometimes yes sometimes no, it could be difficult to know the duplicates (may they are marked). If the answer will be no, then I would include the table anyhow (but can not test the result)...

Made a Pull request for that:
https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/154
